entries.en: grave, solemn; heedless, pays no heed

entries.notes: 闽南语栏声调污损难辨；第二字辨读存疑（形／儀）。

entries.en: majesty, awe-inspiring bearing; such that none dares misbehave toward one
entries.notes: 闽南语栏首音节声调污损难辨，释义据汉字“威儀”与西语栏补足。

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕西语谓“（首字母）表示严重之事”，汉字作“盒”而音写栏 cuà. cāy 与之不相应，四栏互证不明，语义无法定夺
entries.en: uncertain: said to denote a grave thing (as initial letter?); character 盒 does not match the reading or the gloss; unresolved
